Earlier Xuhui Middle School (formerly the Xuhui Public School) of the main building. The school in 1850 to create, now covering 38.6 acres. Chong Si House in January 8, 1917 placed the first stone. June 20, 1918 completed, Shanghai celebrity-studded inauguration ceremony, Lu Yongxiang Songhu Hujun make generals attended the ceremony, the Qing Shanghai Shen Baochang prefectural governor attended the groundbreaking ceremony. Sung Si floor by the Belgian priest, architect and the first design sketches Disney Rendu workers, was called "new school." 1992 renamed "Si Chong floor." Chong even thought the whole building floor attic of four, presenting the French classical architectural design and ancient Greek art of combining classic architectural style. Facade of masonry, interior wooden structure based. Top also had the use of Spanish architectural style, but in the early 1990s due to serious leaking and demolition. Sung Si-floor 孟莎 style beautiful contour, and there is uneven change, is divided into Sec lower section is steep, open French-style dormer windows, the upper relatively flat, open some stingy windows, roof paved with slate gray basket. The whole building brick facade of water, hook gold seam, five sections of the longitudinal approach taken three segments, re-use triangles and mountain fancy curved window lintel on the overall design of the building. The size of each building with a hall, auditorium on the top floor, a small auditorium on the ground floor. Chong thought the building is now a small hall, office, library, music and other fine arts classrooms. Sung Si House completed in 2010 the last renovation.

description_text:
Outdoor bench 3D Model. Production-ready 3D Model, with PBR materials, textures, non overlapping UV Layout map provided in the package.
Quads only geometries (no tris/ngons).
Easily customizable: UV unwrapped geometries, so you can create new Textures (or modify the existing ones) using the UV Layout maps provided in the package (as png with alpha).
Each Object, Material or Texture provided in the package has a unique, meaningful name.
Made in Blender 3D 2.80 (Cycles / Eevee materials) then exported to OBJ and FBX; materials and textures made in Substance Painter, exported for PBR, V-Ray, Unity, Unreal.
PROMO IMAGES: the first image has been rendered in Cycles (or Eevee) for Blender 3D 2.8x; in particular, you can find 11+ promo images in this description:

  - nr. 1-2-3-4-5-6 rendered in Cycles (Blender 3D 2.80)

  - nr. 7-8 are wireframe images;

  - nr. 9-10 are screenshots from the Blender 3D scene, showing the UV Layout;

  - other images: UV layouts (at least one).

Formats included: FBX, OBJ; scenes: BLEND (2.80 with Cycles / Eevee materials); other: png with Alpha.
1 Object (mesh), 1 PBR Material, UV unwrapped (non overlapping UV Layout map provided in the package); UV-mapped Textures.
UV Layout maps and Image Textures resolutions: 2048x2048; PBR Textures made with Substance Painter.
Polygonal, QUADS ONLY (no tris/ngons); 9316 vertices, 9020 quad faces (18040 tris).
Real world dimensions; scene scale units: cm in Blender 3D (that is: Metric with 0.01 scale).
Uniform scale object (scale applied in Blender 3D).
PBR Multi-Engine Textures Pack included: in a zipped folder, you'll find the PBR Textures set for a bunch of rendering engines or game engines!

  - Cycles (or Eeevee) for Blender 3D (base color, occlusion + roughness + metallic + alpha (in a single PNG file), normal);

  - Vray for 3D Studio MAX (diffuse, reflect, reflection glossiness, normal);

  - Unity 5 Standard Metallic (albedo + transparency, metallic + smoothness, normal);

  - Unreal Engine 4 (base color + alpha, occlusion + roughness + metallic, normal);

  - generic PBR Spec Gloss workflow (diffuse + opacity, specular, glossiness, normal, height)

  - generic PBR Metal Rough workflow (base color + opacity, roughness, metallic, normal, height); you can use it in Eevee for Blender 3D 2.8, too;so, you'll be able to edit the Textures, or just import the fbx/obj file, along with the Textures set you want, in your 3D Modeling software or game engine, and link them together to get a game / production ready asset!

IMPORTANT --- Main renderings made in Blender 3D 2.80 + Cycles (or Eevee) using an HDR Environment Texture Image which is NOT provided in the package!

description_text:
DE: Ein Hydrant (von griechisch ὕδωρ hydor ‚Wasser’) ist eine Armatur zur Entnahme von Wasser aus einem Wasserverteilungssystem.
In der Regel werden durch den Wasserversorger festgelegte Hydranten als Teil der zentralen Löschwasserversorgung von Städten und Gemeinden genutzt. Er ermöglicht der Feuerwehr, aber auch öffentlichen (z. B. Straßenmeisterei, Stadtbetriebe) und privaten (z. B. Straßenreinigungsfirmen, Zeltfestveranstaltern) Nutzern die Wasserentnahme aus dem öffentlichen Wasserleitungsnetz (Sammelwasserversorgung).
Hydranten werden genutzt um eine Rohrleitung zu spülen, zu entlüften oder zu entspannen. Im Falle des Ausfalls eines Leitungsabschnittes sind sie dafür gedacht Notverbindungen mit Schläuchen herzustellen.
Spezielle Hinweisschilder weisen im öffentlichen Raum auf Unterflurhydranten hin.
Der Begriff ist auch für Entnahmestellen für andere Flüssigkeiten, beispielsweise Flugbenzin aus einer Pipeline üblich.
EN:
A hydrant (from Greek ὕδωρ hydor, water ') is a tap for the removal of water from a water distribution system.
As a rule, hydrants established by the water supply are used as part of the central low-water supply of cities and municipalities. It allows users to extract water from the public water supply network (collection water supply) to the fire brigade, but also to public authorities (eg road authorities, municipal companies) and private (eg road cleaning companies, tent festivals).
Hydrants are used to flush, ventilate or relax a pipeline. In the event of a line failure, they are intended to produce emergency connections with hoses.
Special signs in the public area point to underfloor hydrants.
The term is also common for collection points for other liquids, for example, airborne gas from a pipeline.
